caption: The drawing depicts a single jug positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The jug is rendered in shades of blue, with a spout, a large handle, and a flared base. The body of the jug features a diamond or lattice pattern, and the handle is thick and curved, attached at the top and bottom of the neck. The jug has subtle shading to indicate three-dimensionality and light reflection. Below the jug, towards the right center, the name "Michael Trekur" is written in black ink or pencil. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Creamer
